_doc: W2-B-DECLARE, A DRAFT SHIFT RECORD (the second wave's charter §0 law L4; the form of the agreement lane's AGREE-shift-record.DRAFT.json). NOT SIGNED: `seat` and the merge commit are the merge seat's. The lane ran no golden door. Base 1930cec6e (the agreement lane's tip) to the lane's tip. THE ONE CAUSE THAT MOVES A GENERATED BYTE: item 5, 1ae138b47 — narrativeGenerator.js :: genCoherence reads the stored flag safetyProfile.flags.theocraticEconomy, not the situation sentence; on the census's 720 it adds one coherence note in 4 births (.coherenceNotes, no other field). Every other commit is a test, a register, a document, a vocabulary entry no line declares yet, or a module no generator or page reads. EACH SURFACE MEASURED, base against tip: the generator golden master by hashing its 525 configurations in both trees exactly as its test hashes them (probes/W2-B-DECLARE/goldenhash.mjs); the five others by running their tests in both trees (read-only) and diffing the failure output byte for byte. CORRECTED BY THE SIXTH SEAT (REVIEW-W2B's third read, finding 3): that sentence missed a SECOND cause. aa41b1f25 (the second seat's DS-GEN-9 cure, src/domain/display/stateProse/generalStateProse.js :: eventAnchorDimension: an event with no anchor flag reads "not anchored") moves 30 rows of the dossier prose manifest, 2 of them newly; the surface is declared MOVED below. It is a display composer: it moves no generator golden configuration (the reader's measure, 0 of 525 hashes differ 9d5d6e091 to c3913f999, a range that holds it). Where a surface below said "by measure" and the measure was a file set, the sixth seat has relabelled it by what was actually executed.
